text.tspan: Building and using an AMI (Amazon Machine Image)
• a customised image: OS, software, config,
• built for ONE region; copy it to use in
• sources: public AMIs (AWS), your own AMIs,
• behind an EBS-backed AMI are EBS snapshots
• move a volume to another AZ → snapshot,
then restore in the new AZ
copy the snapshot with encryption on → create
a volume from it → attach (or restore with
